$comment: Canonical cross-channel listing facts for novada-mcp. distribution/generate.mjs reads this file (never the reverse) and writes the fields each distribution/channels.json row declares as OWNED into that channel's manifest. The description below is deliberately WITHOUT a hardcoded tool/platform count — the whole point is that no channel manifest needs to be hand-updated every time a platform or tool is added or removed. Counts live in ONE place at runtime: novada_discover and README.md's generated tool table, not in distribution metadata.
name: novada-mcp
